title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Dritan Hoxha Street, Tirana(ID: 530201017-649)
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Laprak! Apartment for sale located at Complex E88, on Dritan Hoxha street in Laprak. The apartment is a 2+1 typology with a regular floor plan. Total area 127.51m² and net area 109.80m² 6th floor Orientation Northwest. It is organized in: 1 living room + kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 storage room, 1 balcony. It is located in a quality complex which is organized, two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises. Each staircase is equipped with two quality elevators. The complex is in the final stages of construction. The quality of construction is very good and some of the technical characteristics are: 1-WC, Bidet, Cassette Incasone 2-German production TROCAL windows with double glass filled with gas. 3-Facade with capot system for thermal insulation 4-Laminate parquet 5-Acoustic insulation in the partitions between the apartments The apartment also has a parking post at an extra cost (22,000 euros). The parking lot is located on the -1st floor. The apartment and parking space can be sold together or separately. For more information, please contact us.
